Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: In the second step (the first Planner turn after the initial WebSurfer search), the Planner incorrectly extracted Luis César Amadori's death date as "5 June 1997". The WebSurfer search results clearly showed "1902-1977" and "5 June 1977" in the visible text. This hallucination of the year (changing 1977 to 1997) led to an incorrect baseline for the final comparison, as the actual death date (1977) is different from the recorded one (1997), potentially altering the conclusion if the other director died between 1977 and 1997.
